schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Provides direct income support of Rs.6000 per year to small and marginal farmers in 3 equal installments of Rs.2000 each, directly into their bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs.6000 per year in 3 installments of Rs.2000

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Provides short-term credit to farmers for agricultural needs including seeds, fertilizers, and equipment at a subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum.
schemes.benefit: Short-term credit up to Rs.3 lakh at 4% interest rate

schemes.name: PM KUSUM Yojana
schemes.description: Helps farmers install solar-powered irrigation pumps with up to 90% government subsidy, reducing electricity costs and promoting renewable energy in agriculture.
schemes.benefit: Solar pump subsidy up to 90% — farmers get solar irrigation pumps

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Provides financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to unforeseen events like natural disasters, pests, and diseases through affordable insurance coverage.
schemes.benefit: Crop insurance — compensation for crop loss due to natural disasters

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
schemes.description: Aims to bring every agricultural field under assured irrigation with the motto Har Khet Ko Pani and More Crop Per Drop by promoting water use efficiency.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation — Har Khet Ko Pani

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: Promotes organic farming by providing financial assistance of Rs.50,000 per hectare over 3 years to farmer clusters adopting traditional and natural farming methods.
schemes.benefit: Rs.50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic farming

schemes.name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
schemes.description: A pan-India electronic trading portal that networks existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities, helping farmers get better prices.
schemes.benefit: Online mandi platform — sell crops at best price across India

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides every farmer a Soil Health Card with crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required for individual farms to improve productivity.
schemes.benefit: Free soil testing and personalized fertilizer recommendations

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to houseless and kutcha house dwellers in rural areas to construct a pucca house with basic amenities under Housing for All mission.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1.2 lakh plain area or Rs.1.3 lakh hilly area for pucca house

eligibility.special: Must be houseless or living in kutcha house

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health coverage of Rs.5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to poor and vulnerable families.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh health insurance per family per year

schemes.name: NAMO Drone Didi Scheme
schemes.description: Empowers women Self Help Group members by providing drones and training for agricultural spraying services, enabling them to earn additional income as drone pilots.
schemes.benefit: Free drone training and drone provided to women SHG members

eligibility.special: Must be member of Self Help Group (SHG)

schemes.name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
schemes.description: Aims to make women SHG members financially independent by providing skill training, microfinance access, and market linkages to help them earn over Rs.1 lakh per year.
schemes.benefit: Skill training and Rs.1-5 lakh annual income goal for women SHG members

eligibility.special: Must be member of Self Help Group (SHG)
